patterns.name: Official Structured Product API
patterns.evidence_threshold: Attributable records, bounded pagination, repeatability, provenance, and Deep Audit.
applicable_to: commerce catalogs with public official structured data
not_applicable_to: route names or responses requiring auth/signatures
patterns.repeatability_expectation: same profile must repeat identity and core field semantics
patterns.deep_audit_expectation: identity, price, semantics, provenance, yield, and technique execution gates

patterns.name: Sitemap to Canonical Detail Discovery
patterns.evidence_threshold: Multiple canonical detail records plus repeatable frontier and Deep Audit.
patterns.repeatability_expectation: frontier and detail identity remain reproducible
patterns.deep_audit_expectation: frontier coverage and focal detail quality are audited separately

patterns.name: Structured or SSR Product Detail Catalog
prerequisites: stable SSR or structured item boundaries
patterns.evidence_threshold: Attributable records with semantic numeral rejection and retained source context.
applicable_to: retail details with JSON-LD or SSR
not_applicable_to: application shells without stable product signals
patterns.repeatability_expectation: record boundaries and identity-price pairing repeat
patterns.deep_audit_expectation: identity, price role, variant, semantic, and provenance gates

patterns.name: Rendered Product Detail or Listing
patterns.evidence_threshold: Sanitized bounded rendered evidence with stable item identity and semantic rejection.
patterns.repeatability_expectation: bounded identity and price fields repeat under same context
patterns.deep_audit_expectation: rendered boundaries, identity, price, context, provenance, and drift

patterns.name: First-party App-Bundle Discovery
patterns.evidence_threshold: Bundle clues corroborated by attributable public surface behavior; endpoint names alone never qualify.
patterns.repeatability_expectation: clue and corroboration repeat under a locked profile
patterns.deep_audit_expectation: discovery evidence and extraction quality audited separately

patterns.name: Official API Metadata Acquisition
patterns.evidence_threshold: Deterministic response normalization, request/quota ledger, provenance, refresh policy, and Human Review where semantic authority is needed.
patterns.repeatability_expectation: locked query/profile and quota accounting repeat deterministically
patterns.deep_audit_expectation: coverage, request accounting, provenance, and missing-state semantics

patterns.name: Source-detail Normalization
patterns.evidence_threshold: Identity, attributable value, semantic witness, field provenance, repeatability, and source Deep Audit.
not_applicable_to: summary text without durable raw evidence
patterns.repeatability_expectation: same detail repeats identity and field roles
patterns.deep_audit_expectation: source-specific identity, value, semantics, provenance, and repeatability

patterns.name: Search-versus-detail Price Comparison
patterns.evidence_threshold: Identity correlation plus explicit price roles and variant equivalence; unresolved differences remain unresolved.
patterns.repeatability_expectation: comparison is repeated under equivalent context
patterns.deep_audit_expectation: identity, variant, and price-role gates must all pass

patterns.name: Official Campaign Surface
patterns.evidence_threshold: Offer identity, mechanic, validity/context, and official provenance.
not_applicable_to: generic marketing text without explicit offer semantics
patterns.repeatability_expectation: active campaign evidence repeats within its validity window
patterns.deep_audit_expectation: offer semantics, provenance, time validity, and assigned-technique credibility

patterns.name: Explicit Execution-environment Boundary
prerequisites: same public official surface succeeds on approved normal network
patterns.evidence_threshold: Paired environment evidence with identical technique/surface and explicit approval scope.
patterns.repeatability_expectation: environment decision is revalidated separately from extraction profile
patterns.deep_audit_expectation: access boundary plus unchanged extraction/audit profile

patterns.name: Cloud access boundary
patterns.minimum_evidence: Same locked public surface/method fails in cloud and succeeds on an approved normal network.
patterns.safe_stop: Record environment boundary; require separate Edge decision.
patterns.forbidden_inference: Do not call it extraction failure or assume Edge transfer.

patterns.name: Explicit challenge versus screening false positive
patterns.minimum_evidence: Retained response marker or rendered challenge/login state, not heuristic clue count alone.
patterns.safe_stop: Return evidence-withheld and preserve sanitized diagnostics.
patterns.forbidden_inference: Do not bypass or label a screening clue as confirmed challenge.

patterns.name: Semantic matcher limitation
patterns.minimum_evidence: Accessible response plus retained focal evidence showing exactly which strict semantic gate rejected normalization.
patterns.safe_stop: Withhold record and improve only deterministic offline matcher/tests.
patterns.forbidden_inference: Do not reconstruct a record from indexed or summary evidence.

patterns.name: Insufficient retained evidence
patterns.minimum_evidence: Historical outcome lacks durable raw/sanitized record, ledger, or field provenance needed for verification.
patterns.safe_stop: Classify evidence insufficient regardless of console success claim.
patterns.forbidden_inference: Do not reinterpret historical completion as acquisition success.

patterns.name: Source discovery failure
patterns.minimum_evidence: Bounded official frontier exploration yields no attributable candidate surfaces under the locked method.
patterns.safe_stop: Record no source discovered for that method and budget.
patterns.forbidden_inference: Do not infer that the data or another technique is absent.
examples: Shopee no validated public structured endpoint

patterns.name: Extraction failure
patterns.minimum_evidence: The official surface is accessible and correctly identified, but the locked extractor cannot retain contract-valid records.
patterns.safe_stop: Fail the locked source and preserve diagnostics.
patterns.forbidden_inference: Do not switch method automatically or confuse access with extraction.

patterns.name: Rendering dependency
patterns.minimum_evidence: Static response lacks stable signals while the public rendered surface exposes attributable fields without challenge.
patterns.safe_stop: Record browser/rendered requirement candidate; govern environment separately.
patterns.forbidden_inference: Do not treat any application shell as product evidence.

patterns.name: Product versus variant ambiguity
patterns.minimum_evidence: Stable product identity exists but sellable variant equivalence or variant-specific value is absent.
patterns.safe_stop: Keep product and variant identities separate and equivalence unknown.
patterns.forbidden_inference: Do not merge capacities, bundles, shades, sizes, or marketplace SKUs.

patterns.name: Price-role ambiguity
patterns.minimum_evidence: One or more numeric prices are visible without evidence assigning current/original/range/member/promotion roles.
patterns.safe_stop: Retain raw displays and unknown role.
patterns.forbidden_inference: Do not select a canonical price or infer scaling/discount.

patterns.name: Displayed order is not demand
patterns.minimum_evidence: Only display position under a preserved query/sort/surface is observed.
patterns.forbidden_inference: Do not claim bestseller, demand, popularity, or national rank.

patterns.name: Blocked access is not extraction failure
patterns.minimum_evidence: Challenge, access restriction, or verification occurs before contract-valid source content is available.
patterns.safe_stop: Classify access boundary and retain zero-record evidence.
patterns.forbidden_inference: Do not score extractor quality or source data absence.

patterns.name: Request retention or diagnostic gap
patterns.minimum_evidence: Request/attempt happened but request ledger, sanitized response metadata, or evidence-before-exit artifact is missing.
patterns.safe_stop: Withhold success and repair deterministic evidence writing first.
patterns.forbidden_inference: Do not rely on transient console text.

patterns.name: Wrong host or canonical ambiguity
patterns.minimum_evidence: Requested/final/canonical hosts or paths disagree without a verified same-source canonical relation.
patterns.safe_stop: Preserve all URLs and withhold identity merge.
patterns.forbidden_inference: Do not follow arbitrary cross-host redirects or assert same product.
examples: Roots shop host canonical route diagnostics

patterns.name: Application shell without stable product signal
patterns.minimum_evidence: HTTP success contains only application bootstrap/route material and zero stable attributable product records.
patterns.safe_stop: Classify reachable shell, not usable acquisition.
patterns.forbidden_inference: Do not trust endpoint names, route strings, or large byte counts as data quality.

patterns.name: Evidence authority conflation
patterns.minimum_evidence: A durable candidate or diagnostic exists but independent review/approval authority does not.
patterns.safe_stop: Retain original candidate/diagnostic authority and limitations.
patterns.forbidden_inference: Do not promote Candidate Learning Evidence, Human Review suggestions, isolated staging, or record count into production truth.

scoring_model.formula: sum of six dimensions; higher means earlier consideration within the same authority class

items.reason: Cross-source identity needs an explicit reviewed match corpus and human decisions.
Typed marketplace counters require two reviewed times; current Lazada semantics are unknown and Shopee is paused.
A non-JIB public SPA can test bundle transfer after separate authority.
A generic drift-event contract and deterministic replay need no source request.
Normalize cost/latency accounting over retained ledgers without live calls.
Parked candidates already have reviewed disposition plans; act one candidate at a time only under new authority.
Human-confirmed labels cannot be fabricated offline.
A dry incremental-refresh contract can be derived from validated profiles without acquisition.
One staged same-URL validation is the minimum unresolved Coffee objective, but is not authorized here.
Discovery exists but the required Product and Price track lacks attributable evidence.
Convert the supplied locked-source template into a separately reviewed source manifest before any batch.

tier_definitions.A: Locked & Repeatable: validated official technique, required tracks, provenance, repeatability, and audit evidence with no unresolved execution caveat in the durable profile.
tier_definitions.B: Locked with Caveat: validated method/audit evidence exists, but an explicit environment or non-production approval-scope caveat must be resolved or retained.
tier_definitions.C: Not Batch Safe: candidate-only, paused/access-boundary, Human-Review-dependent, single-route-only, missing required track, or otherwise insufficient evidence.

source_readiness.batch_planning_constraint: Only Tier A is eligible for a first multi-source locked-method manifest without new technique evidence. Tier B requires its recorded caveat to be explicitly accepted; Tier C is excluded.
data_surface_types_available_now: canonical product detail identity and price
official API metadata under provider policy

requirements: no automatic write-back from KU2A to KU2D
